$comment: The fal endpoints this pack offers. Add or remove a model by editing this list — no code. An endpoint is offered only while fal's live catalogue lists it as active and its input schema still carries every field named under `inputs`; its option schema and unit price come from fal (GET api.fal.ai/v1/models?expand=openapi-3.0 and /v1/models/pricing), never from this file. What fal does not expose lives here: how Dimension's inputs map onto the endpoint's fields, how many billing units a request takes (derived from the price text on the endpoint's fal page, checked 2026-10-01), the licence, and the feature tags.

uploads.$comment: Reference images and 3D files are sent to fal's CDN, which serves them by public URL. They are asked to expire after this many seconds; a job needs its inputs only until a fal runner picks it up.

outputRoles.$comment: First match wins, against the dotted path of a file inside fal's result. A model's own `outputRoles` are tried first; a file nothing matches is classified by its extension.

licence.note: Pixal3D's repository is MIT, but the weights' commercial terms are disputed upstream (TencentARC/Pixal3D issue #33, open since 2026-07-09: a ComfyUI wrapper claims academic-only and EU-excluded) and its encoder is Meta's DINOv3, under the DINOv3 License, whose text has not been legally reviewed. fal lists the endpoint as license_type=commercial, which is fal's licence to host it, not an answer to #33. Prototype use only until the owner and legal clear both.

TRELLIS.2's model and code are MIT (microsoft/TRELLIS.2). Its pipeline config (pipeline.json) conditions on Meta's DINOv3 (facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m, under the DINOv3 License) and removes backgrounds with briaai/RMBG-2.0, which TencentARC/Pixal3D#33 reports as CC BY-NC; neither licence has been legally reviewed, so check both before a release export.

fal's Terms of Service (updated 2026-09-08) make Output Content the customer's (§6) and set no commercial-use restriction, give no originality or IP warranty (§4c) and let third-party model terms apply (§14a); fal lists the endpoint as license_type=commercial. Hyper3D's own terms were not reviewed.

pricing.basis: $0.80 per generation (the only price fal lists for this endpoint, whatever the options)
